title: Janus Cristal × FractalGPT Sandbox Gate

lineage.fractal_gpt_recovered_concept: Generate deterministic fractal trajectories/path-selection guidance while leaving the underlying measurement algorithm conventional and independently verifiable.

question: Does a content-independent fractal multiscale search find semantic-looking or geometric candidates in crystal imagery at a rate that survives matched shuffled controls and cross-modality checks?

fixed_measurements: Tesseract OCR with restricted alphabet and confidence threshold
method.negative_control: same fractal windows applied to deterministic 48-pixel block-shuffled image
method.semantic_escalation: token length >=3; >=2 real-window hits; absent from matched shuffled control; word/formula/code-like class
method.semantic_admission: never admitted as intentional message in v0.1

claim_ceiling: This sandbox can compare deterministic search strategies and detector behavior. It cannot establish hidden intelligence, intentional encoding, messages, formulas, code, algorithms, or supernatural causes.
